ModMetaData.name: RedCrow — Insector Tweaks
ModMetaData.author: RedCrow
ModMetaData.description:
Personal balance and compatibility changes for VRE Insector (HSK/CE Patched).
Included: - Expanded skill-specialization degrades divided into Combat, Craft and Intellectual groups. - Group incompatibilities and work restrictions. - Mutation-point rebalance. - Parthenogenesis, Spawning sack and Jelly sacks compatibility. - VFE Insectoids 2 crossover genes made immediately available for the HSK fork.
